dod.description: CLI add, list, search, delete round-trip works against a real JSON file
dod.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d); cd "$tmp"; NOTES_FILE="$tmp/notes.json" python3 -m notes add "buy milk"; NOTES_FILE="$tmp/notes.json" python3 -m notes add "call bob"; test "$(NOTES_FILE="$tmp/notes.json" python3 -m notes list | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = "2"; NOTES_FILE="$tmp/notes.json" python3 -m notes search milk | grep -q "buy milk"; id=$(NOTES_FILE="$tmp/notes.json" python3 -m notes list | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f1); NOTES_FILE="$tmp/notes.json" python3 -m notes delete "$id"; test "$(NOTES_FILE="$tmp/notes.json" python3 -m notes list | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = "1"
